[RDSC.5a.7g.4] **Determinism.** The retention PRNG is a
deterministic function of the input sequence (pure 64-bit integer
arithmetic), and the bag aggregations use only correctly-rounded
IEEE-754 operations (`variance`/`stdev` via `sqrt`); quantiles sort a
**scratch copy** of the bag, so queries are read-only ([RDSC.5a.1a]).
`SeriesBackendReservoir` is therefore **cross-platform bit-exact** ([LDET.3.2]) — see
[LSMP.2] for
the full argument and the relationship to the [LDET.11.4] no-author-RNG
rule.
